bottom: ...thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
bottom: ...And he said, I will redeem it.

top: ...and called the name of it Eben-ezer,
bottom: saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

top: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth...
bottom: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
bottom: but the LORD looketh on the heart.

top: ...Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice,
bottom: and to hearken than the fat of rams.
